about: The quantity a part opens at: the declared yearly quantity when the record priced it, else 10 when priced, else the first priced quantity of 10 or more, else the largest. Read by backend tests/test_catalog_service.py (catalog_service.opening_qty) and frontend src/components/v4/part/opening-qty.test.ts (model.ts openingQty) so the two rules can't drift (ce-19, me-22, op-08).
